# City-Data

> > Comprehensive database of U.S. and Canadian city statistics including demographics, real estate, crime, schools, and business entities.

City-Data provides detailed statistical profiles for thousands of cities across the United States and Canada. The site aggregates data on housing markets, crime rates, school quality, population demographics, and local businesses to help users research and compare locations.

## Key Topics

- demographics
- real-estate
- housing-data
- crime-statistics
- school-information
- city-comparison
- Alabama
- Arizona

## U.S. State City Directories

- [Alabama Cities](https://www.city-data.com/city/Alabama.html): Directory of Alabama cities with demographics, real estate, and crime data
- [Arizona Cities](https://www.city-data.com/city/Arizona.html): Directory of Arizona cities with demographics, housing, and school info

## Canadian Provinces

- [Quebec Statistics](https://www.city-data.com/canada/Quebec-Index.html): Quebec province statistics: population, census, labor, and immigration

## Business & Economic Data

- [Business Entities Directory](https://www.city-data.com/business-entities/): US business entities directory organized by state and city

## City Rankings & Comparisons

- [Largest Cities by Land Area](https://www.city-data.com/top8.html): Ranking of top 100 US cities by land area with geographic statistics
